title: CHAPTER 10: STRATEGIC HRM, CHANGE MANAGEMENT AND OD

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Strategic Human Resource Management (SHRM) aligns human capital strategies directly with business goals.
Organisational Development (OD) applies behavioral science to drive planned, long-term organizational effectiveness.
Change Management focuses on structured approaches for transitioning individuals and teams through organizational shifts.
HR in Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) is critical for culture integration, due diligence, and key talent retention.

blocks.content: Strategic HRM is about integrating HR functions with organisational strategy so that HR practices support and reinforce strategic goals. SHRM recognises employees as a source of sustainable competitive advantage.
